purpose: Deterministic bounded offline-first demo and Lane 9 replay. No live retrieval in tests; credentials optional/unavailable; no external probe.

preconditions.workspace: Local durable workspace exists (empty is acceptable); no production datastore required
preconditions.credentials: None required for deterministic offline demo; BODS_API_KEY / NATIONAL_HIGHWAYS_API_KEY are optional and when absent the demo shows honest not_ready_credential_missing blockers with no live retrieval
preconditions.external_probe: No network probe required; all assertions can be satisfied from typed state and stored artifacts; tests perform no live retrieval
preconditions.determinism: Demo contract is deterministic and bounded: same workspace produces same packet SHA; no external call assumed

REAL_MANCHESTER_DATA: bods_bus_positions (REAL MANCHESTER DATA — bus-only live_vehicle only when BODS_API_KEY present else no_live placeholder; never general road traffic)
dft_historical_counts (REAL MANCHESTER DATA — historical only when accepted snapshot present else not_accepted)
REAL_EXTERNAL_NON_MANCHESTER_DATA: national_highways_operational (REAL EXTERNAL NON-MANCHESTER DATA — strategic road only, near_live only when NATIONAL_HIGHWAYS_API_KEY present else honest blocker; never Manchester city-road)
webtris_historical (REAL EXTERNAL NON-MANCHESTER DATA — historical strategic-road site/day reports only; never near_live)
SYNTHETIC_DATA: manual_incident_authored (SYNTHETIC DATA — bounded authored incident via Scenario Builder; never observed evidence)
SIMULATION_OUTPUT: synthetic_square_sumo (SIMULATION OUTPUT — hand-authored TrafficTwin synthetic-square smoke scenario; Original TrafficTwin-authored synthetic scenario: one edge tracing a 100 m square perimeter with six deterministic vehicles. Not derived from Eclipse SUMO scenario files.; three admitted files pinned: square.sumocfg f63508af4ac0aa9c83baaab4670cb46e6ea2f7757f523d6378f87cdf465c8a1d (538 B), square.net.xml 9dba208715f894606119533ab3c6d3d95133cabe32a910eecc96fd1a47d52126 (1048 B), square.rou.xml 377e955571566c625c82ee43b5c2e63e55a595960a46491dfbb14d540b6ec4a1 (1048 B); not Manchester observation; see src/traffictwin/integration/sumo_execution/scenario_synthetic_square/README.md)
DESIGN_ONLY_CAPABILITY_explicit_unavaila: general_live_road_traffic_bods (DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY — explicit unavailable input; BODS ceiling is bus-only)
live_city_wide_twin (DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY — explicit unavailable input; would require production deployment)
social_media_ingestion (DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY — explicit unavailable input; adapter deferred)

sequence_bindings.action: Render Manchester Evidence Hub; capture readiness table and fingerprint (no live retrieval)
sequence_bindings.expected_output: Fingerprint derived from typed machine state; blockers list contains BODS_API_KEY / NATIONAL_HIGHWAYS_API_KEY missing when absent; DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY sources show UNAVAILABLE/DEFERRED/BLOCKED
sequence_bindings.acceptance: All 11 manifest sources appear with exact human evidence standing and none of the DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY unavailable sources is shown as REAL MANCHESTER DATA

sequence_bindings.action: Open Manchester Operations and inspect National Highways card/scene (bounded, credential-optional)
sequence_bindings.expected_output: When unconfigured: explicit not_ready_credential_missing blocker with no live retrieval; when configured locally: near_live scene labelled REAL EXTERNAL NON-MANCHESTER DATA, strategic-road only, NOT Manchester city-road
sequence_bindings.acceptance: Coverage scope never claims Manchester city-road operational traffic; REAL EXTERNAL NON-MANCHESTER DATA never presented as REAL MANCHESTER DATA
sequence_bindings.credential_requirement: optional — deterministic demo assumes absent and shows honest blocker

sequence_bindings.action: Inspect BODS card/scene in Manchester Operations (bounded, bus-only)
sequence_bindings.expected_output: Deterministic demo shows no_live placeholder when unconfigured; live_vehicle bus markers with staleness labelling only when locally configured, explicitly NOT general road traffic
sequence_bindings.acceptance: BODS (REAL MANCHESTER DATA, bus-only) is never presented as general_live_road_traffic_bods (DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY)
sequence_bindings.credential_requirement: optional — deterministic demo assumes absent; no live retrieval in tests

sequence_bindings.action: Open accepted DfT (REAL MANCHESTER DATA) and WebTRIS (REAL EXTERNAL NON-MANCHESTER DATA) catalogue views offline
sequence_bindings.expected_output: Either bounded chart/catalogue rows or honest not_accepted placeholder; WebTRIS historical never labelled near_live
sequence_bindings.acceptance: Freshness remains historical for both; no promotion; REAL EXTERNAL NON-MANCHESTER DATA not relabelled as REAL MANCHESTER DATA
sequence_bindings.credential_requirement: none — offline-first catalogue; no provider call

sequence_bindings.action: Author one bounded SYNTHETIC DATA incident and materialise synthetic bundle over SIMULATION OUTPUT square
sequence_bindings.expected_output: Labelled SYNTHETIC DATA bundle with mutation ledger and bundle SHA; metric/diagnostic table labelled SYNTHETIC DATA / SIMULATION OUTPUT
sequence_bindings.acceptance: Synthetic/simulation output never mislabelled as observed REAL MANCHESTER DATA
sequence_bindings.credential_requirement: none — bounded synthetic what-if; authored locally, no live retrieval

outputs.provenance: Each input contributes its snapshot SHA-256 / acceptance path / control-state SHA; packet SHA is reproducible from same workspace without live deployment or provider account
outputs.freshness: Declared per source in manifest with human evidence standing; no source promoted
outputs.quality: Bounded by ceiling; SYNTHETIC DATA is SYNTHETIC DATA; SIMULATION OUTPUT is SIMULATION OUTPUT; DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY contributes no quality

lane9_readiness.replay_mechanism: Re-derive packet from same stored SHAs and typed states via scripts/validate_v08_use_case_a.py and direct service calls; no external provider call required; deterministic
lane9_readiness.credentials: optional/unavailable — deterministic demo uses no credentials and performs no live retrieval
lane9_readiness.secondary: Traffictwin replay/registry portability is out of scope for this demo; Lane 9 re-derivation is local-file replay, not production deployment

red_lines: Demo must not claim live city-wide twin (DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY)
Demo must not claim measured road traffic from BODS (DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY; BODS is bus-only REAL MANCHESTER DATA)
Demo must not claim operational general-road current state
Demo must not present DESIGN-ONLY CAPABILITY as implemented
Demo must not present REAL EXTERNAL NON-MANCHESTER DATA (National Highways/WebTRIS strategic-road) as REAL MANCHESTER DATA
Demo must not present WebTRIS historical as near_live
Demo must not perform live retrieval in tests; credentials remain optional/unavailable
